decisions.thought: 89% MOVE: shadowball, 9% MOVE: phantomforce, 1% SWITCH: metagross

Gholdengo leads vs Dragapult. Shadow Ball is super effective and my best play; Dragapult likely faster and may U-turn or DD. If it's physical DD, Mimikyu (Disguise + Play Rough) is my check. Expect Kingambit later—watch Sucker Punch vs Gholdengo. Lum Berry Dragonite kept healthy for Multiscale.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Shadow Ball is super effective vs Dragapult. Dragapult might be Specs or Dragon Dance. Shadow Ball it.

decisions.thought: 71% SWITCH: metagross, 29% SWITCH: garchomp
68% MOVE: earthquake [MEGA], 32% MOVE: earthquake, 0% SWITCH: garchomp

Gholdengo at 40/194 vs Metagross; Metagross may be faster and threatens it. Dragonite (Multiscale intact, Lum Berry) resists Metagross's Steel STAB and is immune to EQ; it can DD and retaliate with EQ. Keep Gholdengo healthy for Kingambit (Make It Rain) later. Mimikyu saved as Dragapult/Garchomp check—Dragapult already dead. Expect Kingambit as their third; watch Sucker Punch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Gholdengo at 40/194 vs Metagross. Shadow Ball is super effective but Metagross is bulky special? SpD 99-156, Shadow Ball 80 BP SE. Metagross likely faster (up to 134 vs my 104). Metagross could hit hard physically — Gholdengo Def 115. Risky. Better switch to Dragonite (Multiscale intact) — Metagross can't touch Dragonite well except Ice Punch/Ice coverage? Metagross could have ice punch. Mimikyu: Metagross steel STAP? Metagross Zen Headbutt hits Mimikyu neutral, Meteor Mash resisted? Steel vs Fairy resisted, Psychic neutral. Mimikyu Shadow Claw hits Metagross neutral... weak.

Actually Shadow Ball from Gholdengo: 80 BP SE = 160 effective vs Metagross SpD. Gholdengo SpA 203. Likely 2HKO? Metagross HP ~170, SpD ~120 → decent damage. But Metagross may outspeed and KO Gholdengo at 40 HP with anything. Recover only gets to ~137; Metagross EQ/Zen Headbutt could still threaten. Safer: switch Dragonite in, Multiscale absorbs Meteor Mash/EQ (EQ immune). Ice Punch would hurt but Lum Berry cures freeze... Ice Punch isn't status. Dragonite EQ hits Metagross neutral (Steel weak to ground? Steel yes, Psychic neutral → SE). Dragonite can DD and sweep.

Switch to Dragonite.

decisions.thought: 99% MOVE: icepunch, 0% MOVE: meteormash, 0% SWITCH: garchomp

Dragonite full HP, Multiscale halves damage; immune to Metagross EQ. Mega Metagross likely faster (Ice Punch 4x→2x after Multiscale hurts). Plan: DD now to outspeed, then EQ repeatedly. Gholdengo low (40/194) — save for Kingambit if possible. Mimikyu at full HP with Disguise as backup vs Metagross/Garchomp. Expect Kingambit third; watch Sucker Punch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Mega Metagross is fast, likely faster than Dragonite (117-178, likely max ~170s). Dragonite at full HP, Multiscale halves damage. Metagross EQ immune vs Dragonite... wait Dragonite immune to EQ. Metagross threats: Zen Headbutt (super effective? Dragon/Flying — Psychic is neutral vs Flying? Psychic vs Flying neutral, vs Dragon neutral → neutral), Ice Punch (SE 4x? Ice vs Dragon 2x, vs Flying 2x → 4x, halved by Multiscale → 2x effective), Meteor Mash resisted? Steel vs Dragon neutral, vs Flying... Steel vs Flying resisted? No, Steel vs Flying neutral... Steel resists? Steel is super effective vs Ice, Rock; not Flying. Neutral.

Dragonite can DD. Metagross may Ice Punch. Best: Dragon Dance to outspeed, then EQ spam. Metagross Tough Claws Ice Punch 4x halved by Multiscale ~2x — could hurt but Dragonite bulky. DD now.

decisions.thought: 99% MOVE: icepunch, 1% MOVE: meteormash, 0% MOVE: thunderpunch

Dragonite at 2 HP but +1/+1 and faster than Mega Metagross. Earthquake is super effective and should KO. If Metagross survives, Extreme Speed priority next. Gholdengo (40 HP) saved for Kingambit; Mimikyu full as backup vs Garchomp/Scizor. Expect Kingambit or Scizor as their last.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragonite at 2 HP, +1/+1, faster than Metagross. EQ is super effective. Metagross full HP — EQ at +1 likely KO? Mega Metagross def 153-222, EQ 100 BP super effective vs Steel. At +1 Atk 306 vs ~170 def... roughly 100*306*... damage ~ 2*100*1.5*306/(25*170)+2 ≈ huge, definitely KO range. Just EQ.

decisions.thought: Metagross at 3% HP; Mimikyu's Shadow Sneak finishes it. Mimikyu full HP with Disguise intact handles their last (likely Kingambit/Scizor/Garchomp). Gholdengo at 40/194 too weak to switch in; save it only if forced. Watch Kingambit Sucker Punch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Metagross at 3%, one more Pokémon coming. Mimikyu can Shadow Sneak to KO Metagross... but Metagross at 3% — Shadow Sneak KO. Mimikyu is better lead-in; Gholdengo at 20% is frail. Bring Mimikyu.

decisions.thought: 99% SWITCH: garchomp, 1% MOVE: meteormash, 0% MOVE: earthquake

Shadow Sneak finishes 3% Metagross. Mimikyu (Disguise intact, Spell Tag) then faces their last: likely Kingambit (watch Sucker Punch), Scizor, Garchomp, or Chandelure. Gholdengo at 40/194 is a weak fallback. Plan: SD on the incoming switch if safe, or attack; Play Rough for Kingambit/Garchomp, Shadow Claw for Chandelure/Scizor.
73% MOVE: stoneedge, 19% MOVE: earthquake, 8% MOVE: swordsdance

Mimikyu Disguise intact — absorbs one hit. Garchomp 78%, likely faster. Plan: Swords Dance now (Disguise blocks their hit), then +2 Play Rough (SE) should KO or nearly; Shadow Sneak priority to finish. Gholdengo (40/194) is last resort vs nothing left after Garchomp — only Metagross at 3% remains, which Shadow Sneak finishes. Watch Rough Skin chip on contact moves.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at 78%. Mimikyu 142 Atk, Spell Tag boosts Ghost moves. Shadow Claw 70×1.2×1.5 (Garchomp not weak to Ghost) = neutral ~126 BP vs Play Rough 90×2=180 vs Garchomp. Play Rough better but 90% acc. Garchomp could outspeed and hit with Dragon/Ground moves. Play Rough does ~180×42/... roughly 40-50%? Atk 142 vs Def ~103-161. Probably ~45-55%. Two Play Roughs needed. Garchomp may have Scale Shot/Earthquake. Mimikyu has Disguise intact — first hit blocked. So SD then attack? Garchomp damage blocked once. SD boosts Play Rough to kill. But Gholdengo at 20% is weak. Best: Swords Dance now (disguise absorbs a hit), then Play Rough twice. Risk: Garchomp uses SD too or dragon moves. I'll SD.

decisions.thought: 84% MOVE: earthquake, 10% MOVE: swordsdance, 6% MOVE: stoneedge

Mimikyu at +2 Atk with Spell Tag. Play Rough is super effective on Garchomp and should KO it (or leave it in Shadow Sneak range). If it misses (10%), Garchomp likely KOs with Stone Edge—accept the risk. After Garchomp falls, only 3% Metagross remains; Shadow Sneak finishes it. Gholdengo (40/194) stays back.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Play Rough at +2 with Spell Tag should KO or heavily damage Garchomp. 90% accuracy risk; miss = Stone Edge hits. Shadow Sneak +2 also decent but weaker. Play Rough is right.
